preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 2 <= n <= 300000 for n in [int(lines[i]) for i in range(1, len(lines)) if i % (n + 1) == 1])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 2 and 300,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges_list)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints u and v are valid vertex indices between 1 and n.
Each test case contains exactly n-1 edges.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 300,000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) and int(line) >= 0 for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a non-negative integer representing the maximum number of saved vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(saved_count == max_saved_for_tree(tree_edges) for saved_count, tree_edges in zip([int(line) for line in stdout_lines], parsed_trees))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output value equals the maximum number of vertices that can be saved by optimally choosing which non-infected vertices to delete before infection spreads, given the tree structure rooted at 1.
